topic: What impact do next-gen feeder link technologies have on satellite architecture for real-time adaptive precoding updates?
response: Next-gen feeder link technologies, such as optical feeder links (e.g., DVB-S2/RCS2 approaches), can impact satellite architecture by enabling more efficient and adaptive real-time precoding updates. However, these technologies also introduce new challenges, including varying link conditions and high fixed latencies on satellite links. To mitigate these effects, advanced algorithms and control mechanisms are required to ensure reliable and efficient transmission of data.
